children: November 19, 2026 – Ottawa, Canada – TheNewswire - Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc.

(“Edgewater” or the “Company”) announces that it has settled its obligation to pay an aggregate of $17,726.30 in interest as of December 1, 2025, $17,531.51 in interest as of March 1, 2026, $17,921.10 in interest as of June 1, 2026 and $17,921.10 in interest as of September 1, 2026 to the holders of its unsecured debentures issued September 1, 2022 (the “Debentures”) through the issuance of an aggregate of 1,421,982 common shares of the Company at a deemed price of $0.05 per share (the “Shares”). The Shares are issued in full satisfaction of the December 1, 2025, March 1, 2026, June 1, 2026 and September 1, 2026 interest payment obligations in accordance with the terms of the Debentures, and represents the 13th to 16th interest payments pursuant to the terms of the Debentures. The debt settlement has been approved by the TSX Venture Exchange.

Certain directors of the Company received an aggregate of 265,995 Shares and therefore the share issuance constitutes a “related party transaction” as that term is defined in Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“MI 61-101”). The Company will rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 as neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the debt exceeds 25% of the Company’s market capitalization.

Edgewater’s patented, AI-powered Wi-Fi Spectrum Slicing™ platform—delivered through the PrismIQ™ product family—enables multiple concurrent channels within a single Wi-Fi band, designed to improve spectrum utilization, reliability, latency and Quality of Service in congested and high-density environments. PrismIQ™ is Edgewater’s Wi-Fi 8-ready silicon solutions platform targeting residential, enterprise, Industrial IoT and high-reliability wireless applications. With 26 granted patents, three AI-related patent applications pending and a capital-efficient fabless model, Edgewater is developing scalable silicon, IP and reference solutions for the next generation of intelligent wireless connectivity. Edgewater is a Silicon Catalyst portfolio company.
